title: 第十五章收服整编第十六章狂信徒
content_zh:
第十五章收服整编已经签约！求支持！
灵魔现在心里那个后悔啊，自己怎么能这么大意，这么多破绽都没能发现！一开是就觉得不对劲，可是自己还是没注意，要是自己当时发现它们的头领周围竟然没有一个四阶高级以上的亡灵就好了，可是自己太过于自负！
也没去在意而且对方手下逃跑也没引起自己的警惕！最让灵魔后悔的是自己的手下被别的亡灵收服了自己竟然没有察觉！
听对方说的话，灵魔才知道来的正是上一次逃脱的亡灵，灵魔现在真的是肠子都悔青了要是有肠子的话！，不过现在怎么后悔都无济于事，想想怎么脱险才是！
看着前面带头的亡灵只有六阶高级的实力，但是灵魔却不敢小视要知道能在自己眼皮子底下收服自己近一半的手下，这种实力却对不是现在的自己能对方的！而且自己追击的那队亡灵可是还有很多实力，灵魔自己现在正是后有追兵前有堵截两面受敌！
陈林带领着刚收服的几百个新的手下，来到了山谷中间和小黑正好把灵魔包围在中间！现在陈林可以说胜券在握，虽然实力比对方的头领差一点！但是因为上一次修炼神魂决直接提升到了凡魂阶大成的水平，而陈林自己也拥有了伪领域的能力！自己进阶高级亡灵那是早晚的事，对方根部就不是对手！
陈林这一次计划看似很顺利。其实中间有很多的漏洞，现在能有这样的效果都是灵魔自己聪明反被聪明误！看到眼前的六阶巅峰的亡灵法师被自己包围，陈林心中的仇恨还是没有消减！毕竟上一次自己和小黑可是差点就命丧于此！接下来就是自己要报仇的时刻了，在跟小黑下了总攻击的命令后，陈林开启自己的伪领域直接冲进了对方的阵营……
然而在陈林开启伪领域的时候，灵魔却是直接被陈林的伪领域给震慑到了，直接选择了投降！陈林对于这个六阶巅峰实力的亡灵法师选择投降感到吐血，就感觉自己准备了好长时间的蓄力攻击，且被对方该躲了过去！本来陈林是打算直接杀了他的，可是在退出神秘空间后，陈林得到了一个信息使得陈林不得不接受它的臣服！
陈林得到的信息是上一次修炼消耗了过多的空间能量，在短时间内是不能够再去神秘空间修炼，那么想要稳定快速的提升实力，就必须用信仰之力！而信仰之力只有拥有智慧的亡灵才能拥有，所以陈林最后还是接受了六阶巅峰的亡灵法师的臣服！
其实灵魔也很无奈，自己本来利用自己的智慧一直存活到现在，可是对方的智慧明显要比自己高！而且实力并不比自己差，现在自己又进入了它们的圈套，自己的胜算很小！在陈林释放出伪领域后，灵魔为了保命明智的选择了投降！
陈林禁魂咒直接收服了眼前的叫做灵魔的亡灵法师，自此陈林又多出来一个忠诚的强力手下。而且还多出来一份信仰之力的来源，因为智慧越高能提供的信仰之力就越强，灵魔提供的信仰之力只比小黑第一点，成为了陈林第二大信仰之力的来源！
在收服了灵魔后，陈林开始寻问灵魔的手下的情况，毕竟还有自己收服的都只是一部分，还有一些因为时间原因直接击杀了！不过看着灵魔剩下的手下也是一股不小的力量！这可都是陈林间接的手下，要是利用的好可是一个很强的势力！
“灵魔，你先还有多少手下！来说给我听听。”
“我有本手下有一千二百二十三名！在主人手中折损二百百多名，收服了四百多名……”说着灵魔很是畏惧的看了看陈林。见陈林没有生气，灵魔接着说道“这些亡灵大多都是远程攻击的亡灵！实力在四阶初级到六阶都有……”
听完灵魔手下的实力后，陈林也是一阵吃惊。幸亏自己第一次反应快，在对方没反应过来的时候就开始误导。要不然肯定逃不出来！
在后怕过后，陈林又为灵魔手下的实力高兴！“现在这股力量都是属于我的了，我要好好利用这股力量，作为我征服亡灵界的第一股力量！”
陈林在惊喜过后，开始整编灵魔的手下！将一些阶位低的全部剔除只留下了一些精锐，毕竟这些低级的亡灵就算是自己的手下也能随时收服！
在陈林整编后的手下是：骷髅法师二百六十三名，实力全部四阶高级以上；亡灵法师一百零三名，实力四阶巅峰以上；骷髅弓手三百四十名，实力四阶中级以上；恶灵四十八名，实力四阶五阶初级以上！骷髅战士九十八名，实力五阶初级以上；僵尸二十六名，实力五阶中级以上！
在陈林整编后，自己手下已经有近千余名手下，而且都是中级后期的亡灵！而且在这次收服陈林还找到了十六名已经拥有低级智慧的手下！现在陈林手下算上灵魔小黑它们，已经拥有二十名的“信徒”了，现在的他猛都能产生信仰之力，而且还是连续不断的！
感觉到不断增加的信仰之力，陈林想到要是自己所有的手下都是智慧生物的话，自己的利用仰之力很快就会达到凡魂阶巅峰的实力，到时候就可以冲击识魂阶了！陈林自己推断自己现在凡魂阶大成，就已经是高级亡灵的灵魂水平了，要是到达识魂阶层次肯定是圣阶的实力！到时候自己就能回到人类的世界了。

陈林想着决定再去神秘空间去参悟下，看看有没有能提早开启亡灵智慧的神通！虽然神秘空间因为上一次修炼使得里面的能量损失过多不能修炼，不过自己在里面参悟神通还是可以的！
接下来陈林开始分配队伍，毕竟以后不能什么事情都要自己带队去做！现在陈林手中有能力带好队伍的只有小黑和灵魔，其它的智慧亡灵因为都是刚开启的灵智并没有多少指挥的能力看看它们没有名字就知道了！所以陈林决定分成了两个队伍：小黑带领着所有的骷髅弓手和近战的亡灵；而灵魔则带领这所有的亡灵法师和魔法远攻亡灵。
就这样一个主近战的小黑带领，主要是小黑超强的战斗力带头，直接冲杀对方在用远程弓手攻击！没有用魔法也就不怕在近战的时候被误伤！而弓手就不要紧了毕竟是单体精确攻击！
另一个主要是魔法远程攻击灵魔带领，而且灵魔本身就是亡灵法师，而且还有全部亡灵法师的，所以根本不用近战的手下，只要召唤低级的亡灵做炮灰在后面用魔法轰就行了！
在安排完后，陈林再一次进入到灵魂里的神秘空间参悟，看看有没有什么神通可以提早开启亡灵的灵智！

Chapter 15: Conquer and Reorganize has been signed! Please support!
The spirit demon feels regret now, how could he be so careless and fail to discover so many flaws! I felt something was wrong as soon as I opened it, but I still didn't notice it. It would have been nice if I had discovered that there was not a fourth-level undead or above around their leader, but I was too conceited!
He didn't pay attention and the other party's men escaped without alerting him! What makes the spirit demon regret the most is that he didn't even notice that his subordinates were subdued by other undead!
After listening to what the other party said, the spirit demon realized that it was the undead that escaped last time. The spirit demon was really regretful now, if he had intestines! , but it’s useless to regret now, just think about how to get out of danger!
Seeing that the undead leading the way only had the sixth level of advanced strength, the spirit demon did not dare to underestimate him. He knew that he could subdue nearly half of his men under his nose. This kind of strength was not comparable to his own! Moreover, the team of undead that he was chasing still had a lot of strength. The spirit demon himself was currently being attacked by enemies from both sides, with pursuers behind and interceptors in front!
Chen Lin led hundreds of new men he had just conquered to the middle of the valley, and Xiao Hei happened to surround the spirit demons in the middle! Now Chen Lin can say that he is sure of victory, although his strength is a little worse than that of the opponent's leader! But because the last time he practiced the Divine Soul Art, he was directly promoted to the level of the mortal soul level, and Chen Lin himself also has the ability of the pseudo domain! It's only a matter of time before you advance to the advanced level of undead, and the opponent is no match at all!
Chen Lin's plan seemed to go smoothly this time. In fact, there are many loopholes in the process. The reason why we have such an effect now is because the spirit demon was clever but was misled by his cleverness! Seeing the sixth-level peak undead mage in front of him surrounded by him, the hatred in Chen Lin's heart still did not subside! After all, he and Xiao Hei almost died in this last time! Next was the time for him to take revenge. After giving the order to Xiao Hei for a general attack, Chen Lin opened his pseudo-domain and rushed directly into the opponent's camp...
However, when Chen Lin opened the pseudo-domain, the spirit demon was directly frightened by Chen Lin's pseudo-domain and chose to surrender directly! Chen Lin felt like he was vomiting blood when this sixth-level undead mage with peak strength chose to surrender. He felt that he had prepared a charged attack for a long time, but the opponent should have dodged it! Originally, Chen Lin planned to kill him directly, but after exiting the mysterious space, Chen Lin got a message that forced Chen Lin to accept its surrender!
The information Chen Lin got was that the last practice consumed too much space energy, and he would no longer be able to practice in the mysterious space in a short period of time. If he wanted to improve his strength steadily and quickly, he must use the power of faith! The power of faith can only be possessed by the undead with wisdom, so Chen Lin finally accepted the surrender of the sixth-level peak necromancer!
In fact, the spirit demon is also very helpless. He used his own wisdom to survive until now, but the other party's wisdom is obviously higher than his! And the strength is no worse than mine. Now that I have entered their trap again, my chances of winning are very small! After Chen Lin released the pseudo-realm, the spirit demon wisely chose to surrender in order to save his life!
Chen Lin's soul-forbidden curse directly subdued the necromancer called the spirit demon in front of him. Since then, Chen Lin has gained another loyal and powerful subordinate. Moreover, there is an additional source of the power of faith, because the higher the wisdom, the stronger the power of faith it can provide. The power of faith provided by the spirit demon is only second to Xiao Hei, becoming Chen Lin's second largest source of the power of faith!
After conquering the spirit demon, Chen Lin began to ask about the situation of the spirit demon's men. After all, he only conquered some of them, and some were killed directly due to time reasons! But looking at the remaining subordinates of the spirit demon, they are also quite a force! These are all Chen Lin's indirect subordinates. If they are used well, they will beA very strong force!
"Ling Mo, how many subordinates do you have? Tell me."
"I have 1,223 subordinates! I lost more than 200 of them in the hands of my master, and subdued more than 400..." As he said this, the spirit demon looked at Chen Lin in fear. Seeing that Chen Lin was not angry, the spirit demon continued, "Most of these undead are long-range attack undead! Their strength ranges from the fourth level to the sixth level..."
After hearing about the strength of Ling Mo's subordinates, Chen Lin was also surprised. Fortunately, I reacted quickly the first time and started to mislead the other party before they could react. Otherwise, you definitely won’t be able to escape!
After the fear was over, Chen Lin was happy with the strength of the spirit demon's subordinates! "Now this power belongs to me. I will make good use of this power as my first force to conquer the world of the dead!"
After Chen Lin was pleasantly surprised, he began to reorganize Ling Mo's subordinates! All the low-ranking ones were eliminated, leaving only some elites. After all, these low-level undead can be conquered at any time even by their own subordinates!
After Chen Lin's reorganization, his subordinates are: 263 skeleton mages, all with advanced strength of level 4 or above; 103 necromancers, with peak strength of level 4 or above; 340 skeleton archers, with strength of level 4, intermediate level or above; 48 evil spirits, with strength of level 4, level 5 or above elementary level! There are ninety-eight skeleton warriors, with level five strength and above, and twenty-six zombies, with level five and above intermediate level of strength!
After Chen Lin's reorganization, he already has nearly a thousand subordinates, and they are all late-intermediate undead! Moreover, in conquering Chen Lin this time, he also found sixteen subordinates who already possessed low-level wisdom! Now Chen Lin has twenty "believers" including Spirit Demon Xiao Hei and others. Now he can generate the power of faith continuously, and it is continuous!
Feeling the increasing power of faith, Chen Lin thought that if all his subordinates were intelligent creatures, he would soon reach the peak of the mortal soul level by using the power of Yang, and by then he would be able to reach the consciousness soul level! Chen Lin himself deduced that he was now at the level of the mortal soul level, which was already the soul level of an advanced undead. If he reached the level of the Soul Consciousness Level, he would definitely have the strength of the holy level! When the time comes, I can return to the human world.
Chen Lin thought about it and decided to go to the mysterious space to gain enlightenment and see if there was any magical power that could unlock the wisdom of the undead early! Although the mysterious space cannot be practiced due to too much energy loss due to the last practice, it is still possible to comprehend magical powers in it!
Next, Chen Lin began to assign teams. After all, he couldn't lead the team to do everything by himself in the future! Now Chen Lin only has Xiao Hei and Ling Mo who have the ability to lead the team. The other intelligent undead have just opened their spiritual intelligence and do not have much commanding ability. You can tell by looking at them that they don't have names! So Chen Lin decided to divide into two teams: Xiao Hei led all the skeleton archers and melee undead; while the spirit demon led all the necromancers and magic to attack the undead from a distance.
Just like this, led by Xiao Hei who focuses on melee combat, mainly due to Xiao Hei's super combat power, he directly charges to kill the opponent and attacks with a long-range archer! Without using magic, there is no need to worry about being accidentally injured in close combat! As for the archer, it doesn't matter. After all, it's a single-target precision attack!
The other one is mainly led by magic long-range attack spirit demons, and the spirit demons themselves are necromancers, and there are all necromancers, so there is no need for melee minions at all, just summon low-level undead to be cannon fodder and blast them with magic from behind!
After making arrangements, Chen Lin once again entered the mysterious space in the soul to see if there was any magical power that could unlock the spiritual wisdom of the undead in advance!
